_doc: LawGPT evaluation cases. must_cite: list of any-of groups (each group needs one hit, matched on act + base section). must_not_cite: sections that must not be cited as verified. must_match / must_not_match: case-insensitive regexes on the reply. regime: expected old/new/unknown law detection. allow_case_mention: trap questions where echoing the user's case name is acceptable.

On 3 September 2024 two men on a bike snatched the complainant's gold chain near the market and fled.
